description: This file contains utility functions for a FastAPI-based web interface related to environment variable checks and UI display. It defines functions to show missing environment variables, display a disabled admin UI message, and generates corresponding HTML responses.

methods.name: show_missing_vars_in_env()
methods.description: Checks for missing environment variables (DATABASE_URL, LITELLM_MASTER_KEY) and returns an HTML response prompting the user to set them if missing.

methods.name: missing_keys_form(missing_key_names: str)
methods.description: Generates an HTML form displaying instructions and the list of missing environment variable names.

methods.name: admin_ui_disabled()
methods.description: Returns an HTML response indicating that the Admin UI feature is disabled, with instructions to enable it.

calls: html content for UI disabled message
html content for missing vars message
